51486313.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to His fused human DHODH expressed in Escherichia coli by surface plasmon resonance assay

original_paragraph.SPR Binding: SPR binding. Surface plasmon resonance (SPR) studies were conducted using a Biacore 8K+ instrument (Cytiva) using a streptavidin-coated SPR chip to capture biotinylated DHODH. A series 8 SA chip (Cytiva) was first docked and primed into run buffer (10 mM HEPES, pH 7.4, 150 mM NaCl, 1 mM TCEP, 0.005% P20, 50 μM DHO, 5% DMSO). Three injections of 50 mM NaOH were used to condition the chip surface followed by a 30 s injection of 30 μg/mL DHODH diluted in run buffer to capture the protein. The chip surface was further blocked with 2 × 30 s injections of 100 μM Amine-PEG2-Biotin (Thermo Fisher Scientific) @ 10 μL/min. A 60 min surface stabilization @ 50 μL/min was used following immobilization to ensure a stable baseline. The test compound (19 or 29) was plated in a 4-point dose response with 5-fold dilutions and a top concentration of 500 nM in run buffer (10 mM HEPES, pH 7.4, 150 mM NaCl, 1 mM TCEP, 0.005% P20, 50 μM DHO, 5% DMSO). The compound injections were preceded by 3 × 60 s startup injections with run buffer and a 4-point solvent correction spanning 3–6% DMSO. The test compound was then injected for 120 s followed by a dissociation phase of 2000 s. The compound injections were carried out at 50 mL/min, 25 °C and with a data collection rate of 10 Hz.

assay_conditions.running_buffer_composition: 10 mM HEPES, pH 7.4, 150 mM NaCl, 1 mM TCEP, 0.005% P20, 50 μM DHO, 5% DMSO
